answer_state_factorial: The five arms of the certificate factorial form a 2x2 of answer evidence by proof state, with the no-material baseline outside it. Each cell gives correct items of 192. Arrows mark the four one-factor edges; the dashed diagonal is the prespecified primary contrast, which moves both factors at once and therefore attributes its null to neither. Reading the edges instead gives a state main effect of +22.4pp.
arm_decomposition: Ten matched arms on one item set, differing only in the solver record. Left: correct on the entailed subset (of 96). Right: sensitivity d', signed. Holding line count, line types, query-entity occurrence count and query-predicate presence fixed and destroying validity alone (broken_chain) removes almost the whole effect, giving a validity share of 98.3%. The misleading arm, whose fabricated final rule points the wrong way, is followed to the wrong answer on 189 of 192 items.
substrate_size_curve: Balanced accuracy for each of ten models with no solver material (open marker) and with full solver material (filled), ordered by parameter count. Chance is 33.3% on the three-class panel. Colour gives the viability verdict under the corrected criterion (minimum per-class recall at least 0.50). Three of ten models are viable; below 1.7B the interface collapses to a single label whatever the solver supplies, and the effect is not monotonic in scale.
